items.prompt: Earlier accepted IDs are {A} and the last accepted timestamp is 5. What verdict does A,X,Q,1,1,1 receive?

options.why: The ID is duplicated, but BAD_SIDE is checked earlier. Returning DUP_ID would skip a higher-priority field failure.
Q is not B or S. That field failure precedes duplicate-ID and timestamp-state checks.
Timestamp 1 is older than 5, but timestamp ordering is checked only after all fields and duplicate ID pass.
Text 1 is a valid timestamp. It is ordering, not timestamp syntax, that would fail later.
